periods.time: Night raid on Eilands' Nikko laboratory
periods.label: 以深海魔女之技支撑哥哥与救回朋友

status.volume_role: critical healer, tactician and fusion-magic enabler
status.condition: severely burned and exhausted but survives

personality.summary: Shizuku is fiercely loyal to Ikki and, despite her barbed manner, deeply values Stella as a friend. She repeatedly identifies Eilands' traps and falsehoods, refuses to be reduced to a burden, and performs the decisive magic that creates the path to Stella's recovery.
flaws: self-blame when her support timing fails
willing to spend herself past safe limits

abilities_owned: fusion of Ikki into Stella using water/cell magic

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Beloved older brother; she fuses with him, heals him and finally sends him into Stella's body.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend she claims aloud as precious; risks death to restore her and later promises to punch her for causing trouble.
relationships.karl-eilands: Enemy and fellow water/cell specialist; he repeatedly underestimates her and is defeated through her interventions.
relationships.edelweiss: Recognizes Shizuku's courage and intelligence, protecting her after the fusion succeeds.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Older brother whose rebuke of Ikki complements Shizuku's own insistence that Stella remains reachable.

periods.summary: Shizuku saves Ikki after Eilands' abduction attack and joins the rescue team despite Itsuki and Ouma's initial obstruction. Fused with Ikki, she supplies missing cells, healing, detection and water/ice techniques throughout the lab assault. She prevents Ikki from walking into a carbon-monoxide trap, helps him defeat Darwin, and later kills Eilands' temporary body with Akabeni Rikka, shattering Stella's container and Abraham. When Eilands possesses Stella, Shizuku protects Ikki with foam armor from Bahamut Soul at the cost of terrible burns. She identifies the logical flaw proving Stella's personality remains, absorbs Ikki to heal herself temporarily, and uses her last magic to fuse Ikki into Stella. This single act creates the possibility of Stella's return. Edelweiss later calls her the bravest and smartest knight present in that moment.

key_events.summary: Sides with Ikki and declares Stella more important than the objections of Itsuki and Ouma.
Supports Ikki's water-double and poison trap, then freezes and detonates Eilands' body with Akabeni Rikka.
Uses her last strength to send Ikki into Stella's body and prove Stella can still be saved.
